==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) We scooped up what was left of Acid Jet out of the sand. (Acid Jet is a villainous variant of me, who wants to reshape the Storyverse in his image. Acid Jet is the being that originally corrupted Celestial Dragon Jet on 09/13/2025. Celestial Dragon Jet was nearly killed by Acid Jet during the 09/25/2025 attack. Acid Jet attacked a Paradise World in a Blood Bear Mech on 09/27/2025, but he was ultimately defeated and dried up in the sand. This dream takes place where that dream left off.) We placed that in a Lucid Light terrarium inside of Leon. (Leon has a vast number of rooms despite the size of his exterior form. It is arguable that he might contain a room for every need, especially since he contains things like the Dimensional Door that lead to other realities.) I then secured the terrarium with the Aegis spell. (I first used the Aegis spell on 07/04/2025 when battling a muscular Pink Were-Beagle. The Aegis spell acts as a divine and nearly unbreakable shield.)
